project.name: Thoth Module Byzantine Fault Tolerance Remediation
project.description: Fix critical gaps between design intent and implementation in Byzantine fault tolerance, cryptographic validation, metrics, and resource management
project.business_impact: DHT operations vulnerable to Byzantine attacks due to missing validation integration and detection infrastructure

critical_issues.title: Byzantine Detection Infrastructure Unused
critical_issues.description: ThothByzantineStateProvider is implemented but never instantiated. Byzantine fault detection framework exists but is not integrated into DHT operations.
critical_issues.impact: System cannot detect Byzantine behavior from colliding nodes
completed_work: Per-member failure tracking in mutate() and read() operations (Delos-doec)

critical_issues.title: No Cryptographic Validation in Quorum Operations
critical_issues.description: Quorum-based store and retrieve operations do not validate signatures. Byzantine nodes can provide invalid data accepted by majority.
critical_issues.impact: Corrupted KERLs can be accepted due to lack of cryptographic verification
remaining_work: Integrate Maat signature validation into quorum operations
Add response validation in completeIt() aggregation

critical_issues.title: Validation Components Not Integrated
critical_issues.description: Ani (KERI validation) and Maat (witnessing) components exist but are not integrated into DHT quorum operations. No validation hooks in store/retrieve flows.
critical_issues.impact: DHT operations bypass all validation, defeating KERI security model
completed_work: Ani validation integrated in append(KeyEvent_) for existing identifiers (Delos-8eoh)
Conditional validation with explicit KERL existence check
remaining_work: Integrate Ani validation into appendKERL() operation
Integrate Maat witnessing into all append operations
Add validation hooks to getKeyState() and retrieve operations

critical_issues.title: Metrics Interface Completely Empty
critical_issues.description: KerlDhtMetrics and GorgoneionMetrics interfaces define empty stub methods. No operational observability for DHT health or Byzantine detection.
critical_issues.impact: Cannot monitor DHT health, Byzantine behavior, or performance in production
completed_work: Comprehensive metrics recording in all 6 DHT operations (42 total calls) (Delos-a157)
Memory leak fix in counter registration (code review)
remaining_work: Wire metrics into actual production usage (currently using noOp default)

significant_issues.title: Multisig Support Incomplete
significant_issues.description: Threshold-based quorum voting not fully implemented. Some paths use simple majority, others use 3f+1.

significant_issues.title: Error Handling Inconsistencies
significant_issues.description: Different error handling approaches across modules. Some fail fast, others retry indefinitely.
significant_issues.impact: Difficult to debug failures, cascading timeouts

significant_issues.title: Resource Management Minimal
significant_issues.description: Thread pools not configured, memory cleanup hooks missing, connections not bounded. No lifecycle management.
significant_issues.impact: Memory leaks, thread exhaustion in production
completed_work: Enhanced stop() with grace period and proper cleanup ordering (Delos-shyh + code review)
Connection pool disposal, Byzantine provider reset

significant_issues.title: No Fork Attack Detection
significant_issues.description: DHT can accept different event sequences from different paths. No detection of conflicting KERLs.
